comment: Hostile display text: markup, ANSI, newlines, quotes, YAML syntax. Service IDs and volume names are VALID (web, worker, data, cache); the hostile text is in `labels:` (service and volume), which a restore line or a generated lane config may echo. Every UI string and the lane's `docker compose config --format json` must show the text as literal data: no link, no style, no extra line, no extra key. compose.yaml is generated from this file by generate.py; `names` is the oracle.
